messages:
incident-bot: [Pager] High failed auth volume + abnormal cookie churn detected from multiple ASNs. Spike started ~10:12 UTC. Affected endpoints: /v1/embeddings, /v1/generate. Error rate (401s) jumped 8% -> 25%. Paging oncall: @maya

maya: Oncall maya here, looking. Any CX-visible errors or support tickets?

customer-success: Seeing a bunch of retries and 401s from two paying customers, escalating to ops. UA strings look like python-requests cycles.

sam: grabbing logs now. Patterns look like cookie-stuffing + token rotation. IP clusters: 45.77.0.0/18 and 185.62.200.0/22. They spin session cookies and rapidly retry. Propose mitigations: quick WAF block for those prefixes, edge-rate slice for anonymous traffic, and a tarpit/challenge on batch endpoints.

nate: agree. Also suggest temporary quota cut for unauthenticated or anonymous keys (5r/min), and disable async batch embeddings to avoid fanout. I'll stand by for sec quick rule.

maya: I'll push WAF + rate changes. Commands I will run on edge:
```
# add quick ip block rule
edgectl waf add rule --name "cookie-stuffing-45-185" --ip-range 45.77.0.0/18,185.62.200.0/22 --action block
# apply rate-slice to embeddings route for anonymous keys
edgectl rate update --route "/v1/embeddings" --slice 5r/min --scope anonymous
```

sam: I'll apply a tarpit header challenge on /v1/generate to slow retries and require a verification cookie. Also setting KV cache dedupe for embeddings keying to reduce downstream load.

maya: WAF rule deployed :white_check_mark:. Initial edge metrics: request volume from those prefixes down ~72% in 2 minutes. Auth-fail rate dropping: 25% -> 13%.

customer-success: Notified affected customers via status page and direct notes. They reported degraded throughput but not data loss.

nate: Good. Next steps: create permanent WAF signature from the transient rule, add anomaly alert on cookie churn and fast session-rotation, and update sec runbook with mitigation steps. I'll own the runbook and signature.

maya: Handoff to daytime oncall @lina for monitoring + postmortem. Leaving notes: WAF rule name cookie-stuffing-45-185, rate-slice set on /v1/embeddings (anonymous 5r/min), tarpit enabled on /v1/generate. If volume rises again, escalate to rate-tier cut and consider temporary disable of batch endpoints.

lina: Acknowledged. Will monitor dashboards and schedule postmortem. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
